response.hostage_policy: Apply TSM Principle #1 (Wait & See, Limit Resources): If a layer goes into Negative NAV (-), hold the position within its wide 1x notional risk parameter (100% adverse move buffer) while deploying subsequent layers on uncorrelated watchlist setups to harvest small, consistent profits (+1% to +3% cycles). Use accumulated buffer (hostages) from winning layers to offset and release stuck NAV (-) positions once net profit is positive.
response.rationale: We initialize our Hostage Hunt Strategy with a 1x notional-to-collateral ratio ($2,500 notional per $2,500 collateral across 4 layers). This provides maximum structural survivability (wide implied SL) to absorb crypto volatility without premature stop-outs, allowing us to flow dynamically with the market. The watchlist balances liquid range-bound majors (BTC, SOL) for mean-reversion harvesting with high-ATR relative strength outperformers (NEAR, ZEC, WLD) for directional momentum.
